about.title: About NgDigest
about.lead: The Angular tech watch that aggregates the best articles, tutorials and community news — automatically curated, every 12 hours.
about.why.title: Why NgDigest?
about.why.text: Keeping up with the Angular ecosystem means juggling dozens of blogs, newsletters, and community channels. NgDigest centralises that noise into a single, scored, bilingual feed — so you spend time reading, not searching.
about.howItWorks.title: How does it work?
about.howItWorks.text: Every 12 hours, NgDigest runs an automated aggregation pipeline across three sources: SerpAPI (Google Search + News), the dev.to public API, and curated RSS feeds. Each result is deduplicated by URL and run through a relevance scoring system before being stored.
about.scoring.title: Relevance scoring
about.scoring.text: Every resource receives a score from 0 to 6 based on three signals:
about.scoring.trustedSource: +3 pts — domain is in the curated whitelist ({{ count }} trusted sources)
about.scoring.keyword: +2 pts — title contains an Angular-related keyword
about.scoring.recency: +1 pt — published within the last 7 days
about.scoring.threshold: Only resources scoring 3 or above are stored and surfaced.
about.stack.title: Tech stack
about.stack.frontend: Frontend — Angular 21 (Signals, standalone components), @ngx-translate, SCSS BEM
about.stack.backend: Backend — NestJS 11, MongoDB Atlas, Clean Architecture (DDD)
about.stack.aggregation: Aggregation — SerpAPI, dev.to API, RSS Parser
about.openSource.title: Open source
about.openSource.text: NgDigest is open source. The full source code — frontend, backend, and aggregation pipeline — is available on GitHub.
